I'm designing three example grids where vertical and horizontal bars intersect, with some crossings showing horizontal bars occluding vertical ones, so the output can demonstrate making vertical bars always render on top. I'm working out specific column and row placements for the bars in the first grid.

Building out that second example with the occlusion pattern, then I want a third variation using different colors (4 for vertical, 6 for horizontal) on an 11x11 grid with vertical bars at cols {1,2},{5,6},{8,9} and horizontal bars at rows {2,3},{7,8}, again with proper occlusion where they intersect.
